audit_items.proof_trace: The canonical ReceiptMessageDecoder (line 16) and the skip-state variant (line 17) produce different RLP encodings. When spec.ValidateReceipts==false, GetReceiptsRoot accepts EITHER encoding (lines 22-28), violating the invariant that optimized encoding must match canonical output.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker crafts a block with receipts encoded using skipStateAndStatus=true format. When ValidateReceipts==false, both standard and skip-state encodings are accepted as valid, allowing two different byte representations for the same receipt to pass validation.
